negative_snippets:
From the moment I arrived, I was struck by the lackluster ambiance and the dearth of warmth in the welcome extended by the front desk staff. The check-in process was an exercise in tedium, replete with interminable delays and a palpable sense of apathy.

Upon entering my room, I was appalled by the shabby décor, the paucity of amenities, and the blatant disregard for even the most basic standards of cleanliness. The bed, ostensibly the centrepiece of any hotel room, was a travesty – a lumpy, creaky monstrosity that afforded me a fitful night's sleep at best.

In conclusion, my stay at Townhouse was an unmitigated disaster, a catastrophic failure of hospitality that left me feeling disillusioned, disgruntled, and downright furious. Unless drastic measures are taken to address the myriad shortcomings that plague this establishment, I would not hesitate to advise fellow travelers to avoid this hotel at all costs.
Worst staying experience ever. No clean rooms. No washed bedsheets. No bedsheet for extra mattress.
